translation: You give off the impression of an alpha wolf.
Meaning?

You're self-centered and don't listen to
others—like a "shut up, just follow me” vibe.
You're just misunderstanding.

I listen when I'm supposed to, then I follow the
best opinion.

It's just that so far, no one has come up with
a better idea than me.

In other words—shutting up and doing what I
say is the best option.

My goodness—she gave the exact sort of
self-centered answer I'd expect from her.

That's the way it is, so how about you share
some constructive ideas every so often?

If you don't use that brain in your head, it'll
atrophy.
Thanks for letting me know.
You're really like a wolf, aren't you?
Seriously?
Let's see, then Kyon would be…

Hmm… I sort of feel like we've talked about
this before.
It was Kyon who brought it up originally.

All things considered, Kyon is very dog-like,
isn't he?

Particularly how he's usually lazing around,
but he'll reluctantly move if you ask.

That's not true… Kyon'll get mad if he hears
you say that.

It's alright. After all, dogs learn a lot from
getting scolded.
Discipline, as they say. Discipline.

I'm correcting that lazy bystander
personality for him.
Like any good owner should.

It's time for him to awaken his loyal instincts
and meet me at the front gate every day.
Um, things have gotten a little off-topic…

If he tragically dies while diligently waiting, I'll
build a bronze statue in his honor.
Are you an alpha wolf?
What are you saying?
He told me.
"He” could only be Kyon.

He's the only one I can imagine coming up with
such crude gossip.

I have no idea what the hell he could be
thinking.
But I have no doubt he's making fun of me.
Yuki, you did well to report this to me!
That is a misunderstanding.
I'll take it out on Kyon later!

This is simply what he told me, but you're
somewhat like an alpha wolf.
Ehh? What's that supposed to mean?

Most likely, that you're the powerful leader of
the group.

I think it describes how you're skilled at
leading those around you.
Hmm… I see…

That's a pretty good comparison coming from
Kyon—even if it's oddly hard to understand.

Otherwise, it may contain dictatorial
implications…

This is Kyon we're talking about, so it's
definitely the latter.

The only thing he's ever good for is
complaining, after all.
Do you think I should discipline him a bit later?

I don't believe he intended to offend you.
Speaking openly about you is a sign of trust.

It's not like you have to defend him or
anything, Koizumi.

I bet he said it with the same boorish face he
always makes.
Spot on—as if you were really there to see it.

I'm gonna give that Kyon so many chores
later, and he's gonna hate it.

Actually, maybe I should just make him treat
us again or something?

…It seems like things took a turn for the
worse.
